title.en: Smart Mark - Mark and highlight any web page with keyboard shortcuts.
title.vi: Smart Mark - Đánh dấu và làm nổi bật mọi trang web bằng phím tắt.

description.en: Smart Mark lets you mark and highlight any element or area on a web page using keyboard shortcuts - outline elements, draw areas, and save layouts. No toolbar, no menus, no mouse required. No data collected; everything stays on your device.
description.vi: Smart Mark giúp bạn đánh dấu và làm nổi bật mọi phần tử hoặc vùng trên trang web bằng phím tắt: viền phần tử, vẽ vùng tự do và lưu bố cục. Không thanh công cụ, không menu, không cần chuột. Không thu thập dữ liệu; mọi thứ nằm trên máy bạn.

jsonLd.name: Smart Mark
jsonLd.description: Smart Mark lets you mark and highlight any element or area on a web page using keyboard shortcuts - outline elements, draw areas, and save layouts. No toolbar, no menus, no mouse required. No data collected; everything stays on your device.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Smart Mark is completely free, with no ads and no accounts.

No. Your settings and marker layouts are saved in Chrome's own storage. If Chrome sync is on, Google Chrome copies them between your signed-in browsers; Smart Mark has no server, sends nothing to the developer or any third party, and the extension contains no analytics or tracking.

mainEntity.name: Which browser does it work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: Google Chrome (Manifest V3). It runs on any normal web page, but not on chrome:// internal pages or the Web Store.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to memorize shortcuts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every action has a keyboard shortcut, and all of them are rebindable from the options page. A toast shows the active mode as you work.
